title: Largest Number
description: Given a list of non-negative integers, arrange them such that they form the largest possible number.
pseudocode:
1. strs = nums.map(String)
2. strs.sort((a, b) => (b + a) - (a + b))
3. if (strs[0] === '0') return '0'
4. return strs.join('')

steps.note: Convert all integers to strings for lexicographical comparison.
Sort using custom comparator (b+a vs a+b). 9 comes first.
Join the sorted string array to form the largest number.
